meta.title: Notifications
meta.description: Fires a system notification — with the official DeepSeek icon — when an approval is waiting, a question needs an answer, or a run finishes. Works on macOS, Windows and Linux, no matter which app you are in or whether the DSH page is open; pending approvals repeat every 30 seconds, and nothing is drawn inside the page. Notification switches, trigger timing, delivery style, copy, and the Windows popup appearance are all configurable under Plugins → Notifications (applied live).
